result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but the promotional banner has severe contrast problems that make its text nearly unreadable, and there are minor inconsistencies in card styling.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white on a very light mint-green background, resulting in almost no contrast. The promo code — the key information — is effectively illegible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark green or near-black text color on the light mint background (or darken the banner background) to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast for body text and 3:1 for large text.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the first card has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second card has a dark circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (e.g., a semi-transparent dark scrim with a white heart) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Thumbnails in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are visually inconsistent — the first card ('Green Bowl Poké') uses a light grey/white background while the others use dark, blurred photo-style backgrounds, making the row look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image treatment or placeholder background across all carousel thumbnails.

issues.description: The promo banner's subtext runs very close to the right edge of the banner and its decorative circle overlaps the text area, adding to the readability problem.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent internal padding to the banner and move/lower the opacity of the decorative shape so it never sits behind text.
